name: Urbanite
body:
You are an expert at surviving even the deadliest urban jungle.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain (urban) class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Appraise, Diplomacy, and Knowledge (local) checks. In addition, your movement is not impeded by crowds or difficult terrain within urban areas.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
